call_llava_next_video_processor: call the LLaVa-NeXT-Video processor to tokenize text and process images or videos into batch features
create_llava_next_video_processor: create a LLaVa-NeXT-Video processor with video processor, image processor, and tokenizer components
get_number_of_image_features: get the number of image features for given original and processed image dimensions using grid pinpoint resolution
get_num_multimodal_tokens: compute the number of placeholder tokens needed for multimodal inputs with given image sizes
get_unpadded_features: get the number of unpadded features and newline features for an image given its dimensions and patch configuration
